profile.headline: Software Engineer at NISC
profile.summary:
	10+ years of experience in software development of Web applications using .NET technologies 
	Worked extensively with .NET technologies like C#.NET, ASP.NET 2.0, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0 and 4.5, ASP.NET MVC 4, 5, ADO.NET, Entity Framework and LINQ, MVC Kendo UI, AngularJS, Bootstrap and JQuery, WCF, WWF 
	Strong Decision Support Systems experience using Business Intelligence & Reporting tools such as SSIS and SSRS Reports.
	Proficient in database design and expertise in SQL Programming, creating stored procedures, creating DTS package using SQL Server.
	Designed database and normalizing tables
	Extensive experience in Banking and Finance Domain.
	Experience in design, execution and reporting of Unit test cases. 
	Well acquainted with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
	Strong fundamental knowledge in SQL queries.
	Knowledge in CMM Level process.
	Good understanding and experience with Object Oriented Programming concepts (OOPs).
	Good understanding and experience with OOPs principles and design patterns.
	Experience in Windows Communication Foundation (WCF), Windows Workflow Foundations (WWF), .NET Framework 3.0 / 3.5
	Experienced in troubleshooting of .NET applications dealing with production issues like performance tuning and enhancement.
	Expertise in data migration projects with (target – source) same database as well as with other databases.
	Experience in migration BizTalk services to WCF Services.
	Experience in migration Legacy application to web using ASP.NET, C#.NET, AJAX and JQuery. 
	Dynamic, alert, and capable of producing high quality work under time constraints.
	Flexible enough to adapt new environments.
	Excellent communication, presentation and problem solving skills.
	Excellent analytical, technical, and interpersonal skills along with strong organizational skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Continued in my role following Meridian Cooperative's merger with NISC.
Developed web applications using .Net 6, ASP.Net Core Web API, Dapper ORM and PL/SQL, Visual Studio
2019/2022.
Developed PL/SQL functions to get the data from Oracle 19c databases.
Good experience in handling the Git and Atlassian Tools like JIRA, Confluence, Crucible and Bit Bucket.
